card.name: Just before a closing period or quote
card.fires_on: The last letter or word right before a period, often in abbreviations (U.S., D.H., a.m.) or at the end of a quoted definition. The next token is expected to be a period or closing punctuation.

modes.label: Inside abbreviations
modes.description: The letter or piece just before the period in a dotted abbreviation or a citation.

modes.label: End of quoted definition
modes.description: The final word of a quoted gloss in a usage guide, right before the closing quote and period.

card.plain: It fires on the last bit of a word or abbreviation just before a period ends it.
